h1: Custom Over the Ear Personal Protection Equipment
metaTitle: Custom Over the Ear PPE | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom over the ear personal protection equipment for your team. Bulk pricing and fast turnaround from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Over the ear personal protection equipment offers a secure fit and consistent noise reduction for workers in loud environments. Unlike earplugs that can loosen or get lost, over the ear styles stay put during long shifts. Customize with your logo via pad printing or debossing for a professional look that reinforces safety culture. Ideal for construction crews, manufacturing plants, and warehouse teams.
heroAltText: Custom over the ear personal protection equipment with logo on ear cups for workplace safety
